svg.aria-label: Pass@1 on the 54 DataAgentBench leaderboard questions by agent version in the order they were built, one trial each, drawn as the Runs tab draws it: one point per version, an accent line joining the versions that held the title, from v0 at 0.440 through v2, v4 and v6 to v8 at 0.904, with the answers gained at each promotion on the line. Open points did not take the title: v1 the SQL rebuild below v0, v3 beaten by the model switch, v5 by round three, v7 tied v6 on answers and lost on SQL. Under each version, how it was made: base, a rebuild, an optimiser round, or a model change to Sonnet or Opus. The public leaderboard's first and second places are dashed lines at 0.947 and 0.906 over five trials; v8's point sits on the second.
svg.title: 0.440 to 0.904 along the champion line; v8 sits on the board's second line, one trial against five

v0 · Pass@1 0.440 · 27 of 54 · claude-haiku-4-5, the python analyst with nine tools and a sandbox, no hints · the first champion · run 20260921T064521Z, $8.96

v1_sql · 0.425 · 24 of 54 · a rebuild on Haiku: three tools, one SQL statement per question, hints on, the curated pack off · below v0, kept because every failure now had a statement to diff against a golden · SQL 13 of 49 · did not take the title
v2_sql · 0.559 · 30 of 54 · round 1: eleven Sonnet sessions read v1's failed train questions with their golden diffs and wrote dataset notes, $1.11 · promoted under D30, +3 answers · SQL 18 of 49

v3_sql · 0.573 · 32 of 54 · round 2: the reader's seven-step ledger, component sessions write the SQL playbook, plan-first, $1.25 · beaten by its own prompt on Sonnet (v4) · SQL 19 of 49 · did not take the title
v4_sql · 0.738 · 41 of 54 · v3's prompt files on claude-sonnet-5, a model change and not a round · promoted under D36, +11 answers · SQL 27 of 49
v5_sql · 0.842 · 45 of 54 · v4's prompt files on claude-opus-5-5, a model change · beaten by round 3 (v6) · SQL 28 of 49 · did not take the title
v6_sql · 0.891 · 46 of 54 · round 3 on Opus, reader and optimiser on Opus too, $1.90 · promoted under D36, +5 answers · SQL 33 of 49, the most of any version
v7_sql · 0.884 · 46 of 54 · round 4: every error of the 54 read, guards G1–G4 on, $4.39 · tied v6 on answers, lost SQL 30 to 33 · held · did not take the title

v8_sql · 0.904 · 48 of 54 · round 5: round 4's recipe plus each failed question's history from MLflow, $4.83 · promoted under D46, the leak gate then Pass@1, +2 answers · SQL 31 of 49 · McNemar on answers against v6 +3 −1, p 0.63 · the champion
